name: Immersion freezing of marine-aerosol droplets
plain_name: Measure when a cloud droplet freezes
description: Atmospheric ice-nucleation experiment with a droplet,gas conditioning and optical observation.
keywords: Measure when a cloud droplet freezes

requirements.rationale: Images identify each discrete freezing event.
The source requires gas mixing and hygrometer control to prevent evaporation/condensation; stage gas ports alone are insufficient.

missing_information: Published equipment is LTS350; LTS120 is a different real candidate and its full gas/dewpoint assembly remains UNKNOWN.
The stage's maximum cooling rate is not proof of an arbitrary controlled ramp at the cold endpoint.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
